title: Nahuatl, Zacatlán-Ahuacatlán-Tepetzintla
text: Zacatlán-Ahuacatlán-Tepetzintla Nahuatl, spoken by around 20,000 people in Mexico, is part of the Uto-Aztecan family. It is vital to cultural identity in Zacatlán, Ahuacatlán, and Tepetzintla.

title: Nahuatl, Zacatlán-Ahuacatlán-Tepetzintla... | Ethnologue Free
text: Zacatlán-Ahuacatlán-Tepetzintla Nahuatl is a stable indigenous language of Mexico. It belongs to the Uto-Aztecan language family. The language is used as a first language by all in the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
